title: MIDI keyboard
ask: Turning this on asks your browser to let Fermata hear the keys you play on a MIDI keyboard; what you play never leaves this device.
none: No MIDI keyboard is connected. Plug one in and Fermata hears it straight away.
denied: Your browser did not allow it, so Fermata cannot hear a MIDI keyboard. You can change this in your browser’s settings for this site.
error: Your browser could not reach the MIDI keyboard. Turn this off and on again to try once more.
unsupported: This browser cannot use a MIDI keyboard; Chrome, Edge or Opera on a computer, or Chrome on Android, can.
soundBlocked: Click or tap the page once so Fermata can sound what you play.
